messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Rob L., email (email hidden)

Rob, your two Thor P2s (order Shop····) are in transit from our Tennessee warehouse and should arrive by November 15. You can track them here: (tracking link hidden)

Your Magic M. 40T on Shop···· ships December 7.

The KBOX hasn't reached us yet. Its return label is ready, so drop it at UPS with Shop···· written on the box.

Your request to swap the Thors for a second 40T is still with the team. They'll email you their answer, so keep the Thor box sealed when it arrives.
I didn't see an email from anyone on shipping this back who would the email have come from

Rob, we emailed you on November 11 from (email hidden) That email said your KBOX return was approved and included the prepaid UPS label, tracking ····.

Some of our emails have been going to junk or spam, so please check there. Adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts will help future emails reach your inbox.

There's no return email for the Thors yet. That one comes after the team decides on your request for a second 40T.

You're welcome, Rob. The KBOX can go back now with its label and Shop···· on the box. When the Thors arrive, keep that box sealed. The team will email you their answer on the second 40T, along with what to do with the Thors.
